commitResults.messageBody:
clear confirm now also clears the maintenance task list, preventing
orphaned tasks from remaining after all contractors are removed.

Fix clear command not clearing maintenance tasks

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix report using filtered person list for contractor lookup
commitResults.messageBody:
report was using getFilteredPersonList() with an absolute contractor
index, causing wrong contractor info when the list was filtered via
findc. Now consistently uses the full person list (allPersons).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Fix report using filtered person list for contractor lookup

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix delt blocking deletion of tasks with deleted contractors
commitResults.messageBody:
delt was throwing an error when the assigned contractor no longer
exists, making orphaned tasks impossible to clean up. Now allows
deletion regardless, showing 'Unknown (deleted)' for the contractor.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Fix delt blocking deletion of tasks with deleted contractors

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix donet/delt operating on full list when history filter is active
commitResults.messageBody:
donet and delt were using the full unfiltered task list for index
resolution, so after 'history f/FACILITY' the visible indices did not
match the actual indices used. Both commands now use the filtered task
list, and delt removes by object reference instead of raw index.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Fix donet/delt operating on full list when history filter is active
